description: Source code for the SMP (Simple Management Protocol) client implementation in Zephyr OS, including request handling, header initialization, response processing, and command transmission.

methods.name: smp_read_hdr
methods.description: Reads and converts SMP header fields from a net_buf to a smp_hdr structure.

methods.name: smp_header_init
methods.description: Initializes an SMP header with specified parameters.

methods.name: smp_client_transport_work_fn
methods.description: Handles retransmission and response timeout logic for queued SMP commands.

methods.name: smp_client_init
methods.description: Initializes SMP client data structures and work items.

methods.name: smp_client_cmd_req_allocate
methods.description: Allocates a command request structure from the free list.

methods.name: smp_cmd_add_to_list
methods.description: Adds a command request to the active list and schedules timeout.

methods.name: smp_client_cmd_req_free
methods.description: Frees a command request, removing it from active list and returning to free list.

methods.name: smp_client_response_discover
methods.description: Finds the matching command request for an incoming response header.

methods.name: smp_client_object_init
methods.description: Initializes an SMP client object with transport and work structures.

methods.name: smp_client_single_response
methods.description: Processes an incoming response buffer, matching it to a request and invoking callback.

methods.name: smp_client_buf_allocation
methods.description: Allocates a new SMP buffer with initialized header.

methods.name: smp_client_send_cmd
methods.description: Sends an SMP command, setting up request structure and queuing for transmission.
